redmodCli.requiredInvocationRule: Biology tooling must pass -root=<Cyberpunk 2077> explicitly and must not rely on REDmod's default-root heuristic.

playerFlow.prerequisite: Cyberpunk 2077 2.31 plus official REDmod support installed for the player's platform/store
playerFlow.firstInstall: close game; copy the game-root-shaped Biology release contents into Cyberpunk 2077 so mods/Biology lands intact; run supported REDmod deployment/enable flow; launch normally through Steam after deployment
playerFlow.developerDeterministicDeploy: pwsh ./tools/Deploy-BiologyRedmod.ps1 -GameRoot '<Cyberpunk 2077>' after the package contents have been installed; helper always invokes official redMod.exe with an explicit -root
playerFlow.normalLaunch: Steam / supported normal Cyberpunk launch after REDmod is enabled
playerFlow.update: close game; use the installed biology/build-manifest.json as the prior exact ownership record; replace/remove only accounted Biology/dependency-owned files; install the newer package; redeploy REDmod when package content changed
playerFlow.disable: disable REDmod-compatible mods through the supported launcher/store flow; this is not uninstall, save deletion, or proof that supplemental scripting/framework files are unloaded without the documented session boundary
playerFlow.uninstall: close game; remove only exact paths listed by biology/build-manifest.json whose ownership is accounted for; remove empty Biology-owned directories only; never recursively delete shared framework/game roots

supplementalRuntime.ownershipRule: Supplemental files outside mods/Biology are owned/accounted per file. Their parent directories remain shared and are never recursively Biology-owned.
supplementalRuntime.settingsRemovalBlocker: Mod Settings remains the current accessible/persistent provider for the two already provider-neutral Biology booleans. ArchiveXL and RED4ext remain only transitively. Route replacement to Lane C; do not redesign settings semantics in packaging.

ownerManifest.rule: Every ordinary installed payload file is listed exactly once. SHA256SUMS.txt hashes the finalized owner manifest and every final artifact file except SHA256SUMS.txt itself. Uninstall removes exact accounted files and then empty Biology-owned directories only.

conditionalSupplementalRoots.condition: Current merged Biology runtime is REDSCRIPT-BETTER. Exact files must be listed individually in the owner manifest.
Only exact pinned redscript files listed by the owner manifest. Directory remains shared.
Only exact pinned redscript configuration files listed by the owner manifest. Directory remains shared.
Only exact pinned redscript configuration files listed by the owner manifest. Directory remains shared.
Only exact pinned temporary RED4ext/ArchiveXL/Mod Settings files listed by the owner manifest while the Lane C settings-provider blocker remains. Directory remains shared.
Only exact pinned temporary RED4ext loader file if present in the retained component deployment. Directory remains shared and game-owned.
Tracked redistribution notice snapshots for exactly the bundled generic components.

cleanRoom.reason: This candidate changes package authority to REDmod-first and narrows the dependency/runtime layout from the pre-refactor package. The first attended acceptance must therefore use the MILESTONE CLEAN-ROOM workflow coordinated by the parent integration thread.

remainingDirectGameGates: clean uninstall/reset against recorded vanilla baseline
rules: The repository root is not a player package.
mods/Biology is the authoritative first-party REDmod namespace.
Shared framework/game roots are never deleted wholesale, even when exact dependency files are bundled by the integrated candidate.
The playable builder may read the installed supported game for version/exact compilation but may not deploy or modify it.
If the installed owner manifest is missing or hashes/collisions cannot be accounted for, reset fails closed and escalates to the documented milestone clean-room procedure.
No successful CI/build result is live-game acceptance.
